introduction.title: Technology to measure, control, and connect.
introduction.description: We identify specialized technologies for water, gas, energy, and industrial applications, based on operating conditions and technical requirements.
introduction.mediaAlt: Water monitoring, biogas analysis, industrial instrumentation, and SCADA connectivity.

categories.title: Water systems where measurement and control matter.
categories.copy: Relevant contexts include water networks and infrastructure applications where flow measurement, pressure management, control and monitoring are considered together.
categories.mediaAlt: Water infrastructure equipment for flow measurement and network monitoring.

categories.title: Measurement and analysis for energy and process environments.
categories.copy: Gas, biogas and energy requirements depend on measurement, analysis and process conditions that must be assessed together.
categories.mediaAlt: Gas and biogas process measurement equipment.

categories.title: Industrial technology framed around the process.
categories.copy: Industrial requirements can include the measurement, sensing, control and tooling needed to support process and infrastructure operations.

categories.title: Connect field context with operational visibility.
categories.copy: SCADA, RTUs, IoT, data loggers, telemetry and data platforms are relevant contexts for connecting field information with operational visibility.
